<p class="kicker">IUT Blagnac</p>

# DNS course

Everything for the Domain Name System (DNS) course: the slides, the two labs and the Dig Quest game. Follow the cards in order: slides first, then the labs.
:::

::: {.cards}

::: {.card}
<p class="step">Step 1 · Course</p>

## DNS Fundamentals

The course slides: how names are organised, how a resolver finds an answer, caching, records, security.

- [Open the slides](dns-fundamentals.html){.button}
- [Download the slides as PDF](Domain-Name-System-Fundamentals.pdf)
:::

::: {.card}
<p class="step">Step 2 · Lab</p>

## Dig lab

Query real DNS servers with `dig` and read what they answer. Keep the cheat sheet open while you work.

- [Open the dig lab on GitHub](https://github.com/jmanteau/dns-course-labs/tree/main/dns-dig-lab){.button}
- [Download the dig cheat sheet (PDF)](dig-cheatsheet.pdf)
:::

::: {.card}
<p class="step">Step 3 · Game</p>

## Dig Quest

The dig lab as a game, with a score and a class leaderboard. Your teacher gives you the link and the session code in class.

When every mission is solved, the advanced missions open. Read these slides first:

- [Open the DNS Beyond the Basics slides](dns-advanced.html){.button}
:::

::: {.card}
<p class="step">Step 4 · Lab</p>

## Cyber lab

Act as an attacker who hides traffic inside DNS, then as the defender who finds and blocks it. Needs Docker on your computer.

- [Open the cyber lab on GitHub](https://github.com/jmanteau/dns-course-labs/tree/main/dns-cyber-lab){.button}
:::

:::

## Using the slides

| Key | What it does |
|-----|--------------|
| <kbd>→</kbd> / <kbd>←</kbd> | Next or previous slide |
| <kbd>F</kbd> | Full screen |
| <kbd>S</kbd> | Speaker notes, in a new window |
| <kbd>B</kbd> | Blank board to draw on (<kbd>Del</kbd> clears it) |
| <kbd>C</kbd> | Draw on the current slide |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | Overview of all slides |

To print a deck, add `?print-pdf` to its address, open it in Chrome, then print to PDF.
